_note: CYP2D6 clinical inhibitors exactly as classified in the FDA table (strong = >=5-fold AUC increase of a sensitive substrate, moderate = 2 to <5-fold, weak = 1.25 to <2-fold). CPIC opioids 2021 adjusts the activity score for strong (x0) and moderate (x0.5) only; weak inhibitors get no adjustment.
_design_choice: If several inhibitors are listed, apply the strongest only (project choice, not a CPIC rule).
